Prevention: Trim the bunds before crop sowing to prevent egg laying by pest.
Destroy the pupae by ploughing at least 10 cm deep during the summer.
Plant border crop with red gram/cowpea/black gram to increase natural enemies.
Grow trap crop of castor or chrysanthemum around the field for attracting the pest towards the trap crop.
Monitoring: Set up light trap (1/acre from planting) and observe during 6 to 8 pm.
Adult moths have a 40 mm wing span and dull brown forewings.
Observe longitudinal cut holes on pods by pulling the entire infested plant.
See faecal matter inside pods from the 45th day in removed plants.
Direct Control (Non-chemical): Spray a solution of 250 ml of
Equivalents (LE) + 1 kg palm jaggery + 200 litre of water/ acre.
Spray in the evening hours with a hand sprayer.
Bacillus thuringiensis at 2 g in 1 litre of water at 15 day intervals for a maximum of 3 times.
NSKE in 500 litres of water for 8 hours.
Filter and add 500 ml of teepol to spray 1
Neem oil at 30 ml in 1 litre of water at 15 day intervals.
Trichogramma chilonis at 1 lakh/Ha at 40 and 50 days after sowing (DAS).
Direct Control (Chemical): When using a pesticide or botanical, always wear protective clothing and follow the instructions on the product label, such as dosage, timing of application, pre-harvest interval, max number of sprays, restricted re- entry interval.
Do not empty into drains and water sources.
Chlorpyrifos 3 ml per litre of water at 15 days interval
Quinolphos 2 ml/l of water at 15 day intervals
